Hello All,

Does anyone have a comprehensive list of all the sets that include
draft text on the cards? I'm doing a small draft event this weekend,
and I'm letting the players pick among many different sets. To
maximize fun, I thought they might want to know which sets have draft
text.

Also, does anyone know where I can see draft text for all the sets?

Finally, can someone remind me how to properly read draft text? I
know if a celerity card says "[aus]: As [cel], above." It doesn't
mean that if you have [AUS] you get to use [CEL]. One area that's
fuzzy to me are the clan cards. If a card requires Baali and has
draft text without any clan symbol shown, then any clan can use the
draft text, right?

Thanks,
Ira

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Feb 5, 7:49 pm, "ira...@gmail.com" <ira...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Finally, can someone remind me how to properly read draft text?  I
> know if a celerity card says "[aus]: As [cel], above."  It doesn't
> mean that if you have [AUS] you get to use [CEL].  One area that's
> fuzzy to me are the clan cards.  If a card requires Baali and has
> draft text without any clan symbol shown, then any clan can use the
> draft text, right?

1.6.1.6 Draft Effects. Some cards have a special booster-pack version
that also lists, in a gray box identified as "DRAFT:", an additional
way to use the card. This effect can only be used in a draft or sealed
deck tournament. Any bold text, like "+1 stealth action", in bold at
the top of the regular text applies to the whole card, including the
draft effect. Card cost applies as normal to the draft effect, as
well. Clan and Discipline requirements are given in the draft effect
section (and are independent of any Clan or Discipline requirement of
the regular effects).
